01

“and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a precedence of truth with their Lord [Yunus 2]: "that they have good with their Lord."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ [يونس: 2] : «أَنَّ لَهُمْ خَيْرًا عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ»
Edition record 372328 · p. 379Link to report ↗
02

“He arranges [every] matter”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:3).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
He arranges [every] matter [Yunus 3] he said: "He decides the matter alone."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ [يونس: 3] قَالَ: «يَقْضِي الْأَمْرَ وَحْدَهُ»
Edition record 372329 · p. 379Link to report ↗
03

“Indeed, He begins creation and then repeats it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:4).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Indeed, He begins creation and then repeats it [Yunus 4] He says: "He creates it, then causes it to die, then repeats it, meaning: gives it life."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
إِنَّهُ يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ [يونس: 4] يَقُولُ: " يَخْلُقُهُ، ثُمَّ يُمِيتُهُ، ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ يَعْنِي: يُحْيِيهِ "
Edition record 372330 · p. 379Link to report ↗
04

“and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure in it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:7).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure in it [Yunus 7] he said: It is like His words: 'Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornment, We shall repay them for their deeds therein' [Hud 15], the verse.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَرَضُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاطْمَأَنُّوا بِهَا [يونس: 7] قَالَ: «هُوَ مِثْلُ قَوْلِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نَوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فِيهَا» الْآيَةَ
Edition record 372331 · p. 379Link to report ↗

06

“And if God were to hasten for the people the evil as they hasten for…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:11).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And if God were to hasten for the people the evil as they hasten for the good [Yunus 11] he said: "It is a man's saying ⦗p. 380⦘ to his children, family, and wealth when he is angry with them: 'O God, do not bless it; O God, curse it.' He says: if that were hastened for him"; their term would have been decreed for them [Yunus 11], that is: "the one he prayed against would perish and he would cause him to die."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ اسْتِعْجَالَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرِ [يونس: 11] قَالَ: " هُوَ قَوْلُ الرَّجُلِ ⦗ص: 380⦘ لِوَلَدِهِ وَأَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ إِذَا غَضِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُبَارِكْ فِيهِ، اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْهُ، يَقُولُ: لَوْ عُجِّلَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ ". لَقُضِيَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ [يونس: 11] أَيْ: «لَهَلَكَ مَنْ دَعَا عَلَيْهِ فَأَمَاتَهُ»
Edition record 372333 · p. 379Link to report ↗
07

“And mankind were not but one community, then they differed”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:19).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And mankind were not but one community, then they differed [Yunus 19] "meaning by mankind: Adam alone; then they differed, meaning: when the son of Adam killed his brother."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ إِلَّا أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَاخْتَلَفُوا [يونس: 19] " يَعْنِي بِالنَّاسِ: آدَمَ وَحْدَهُ، فَاخْتَلَفُوا، يَعْنِي: حِينَ قَتَلَ ابْنُ آدَمَ أَخَاهُ "
Edition record 372334 · p. 380Link to report ↗

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

11

“Then is He who guides to the truth”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:35).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Then is He who guides to the truth [Yunus 35] "that is God" more worthy to be followed, or he who guides not unless he is guided? [Yunus 35] "that is the idols."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:46).

Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

الإسناد

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:85).

20
Explanation from Mujāhid 20

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

Do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people [Yunus 85], meaning: "do not punish us at the hands of the people of Pharaoh, so that they say: 'If they were on the truth they would not have been punished at our hands, nor would we have been given power over them,' and so they are tempted by us; nor with punishment from You."

Explanation from Mujāhid 23

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Our Lord, obliterate their wealth [Yunus 88] He says: "destroy it"; and harden their hearts [Yunus 88] meaning: "[with] misguidance"; so they will not believe [Yunus 88] meaning: "in God, despite the signs they see," until they see the painful punishment [Yunus 88].

English
Transmission wording

Explanation from Mujāhid 27

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

الإسناد
